note: Everyone who speaks or is named in Docs/CampaignBible.md and Docs/Story.md, except Warrok (retired, never added). code is the speaker letter in Story.cs lines (C, B and T are directives and tips, not speakers). colour is the name and the portrait disc. portrait is an optional Resources path; with no file the dialogue box draws a stand-in disc with the glyph. voice is the hook: wallit and slice speak through WallitVoice and SliceVoice, bark means the Cast.LineSpoken hook only (Resources/Voice/<id>_<line>.mp3 when it exists), none is text alone. voiceId is the Hawkes Gen voice (hv_* house voices, or Wallit's ElevenLabs id), direction its delivery, provider open or elevenlabs. Lines are Resources/Voice/<id>_<line slug>.mp3 (Tools/Audio/collect_lines.py).

members.bible: Narration over the frozen Hollow and the finale
members.direction: warm, even, bureaucratic, faintly amused: a records clerk reading a fairy tale

members.name: WALLIT
members.bible: The player: a wallet with a wooden bat. Talks money.

members.name: SLICE
members.bible: Goth guard of the circle, scalpel knife. Clipped.
members.direction: cool, low, dry and clipped, almost no emotion; answers in one word

members.name: YO BOT
members.bible: The Clearing Crew: chirpy small bots. Small, Plated, Mega.
members.direction: chirpy, bright, fast, like a cheerful appliance

members.name: MEGA YO BOT
members.bible: Reads the order aloud from wave 20.
members.direction: loud, official, reading an order aloud

members.name: THE COURIER
members.bible: Chapter 1 boss: Alpha Yo Bot with a clipboard and a notice of striking.
members.direction: chirpy postal clerk, bright mid voice, upbeat and unbothered, short notices

members.name: THE PLATED ALPHA
members.bible: Chapter 2 boss: Plated Yo Bot stamped INVALID.
members.direction: clipped and metallic, stamped and final, even pace, no warmth

members.name: THE FOREMAN
members.bible: Chapter 3 boss: Mega Yo Bot Alpha that reads the order on its charges.
members.direction: gravelly site boss, deep and flat, reads overtime as law

members.name: THE HALF-BUILT
members.bible: Chapter 3: a Yo Bot not finished, on a hook.

members.name: THE SERVER
members.bible: Chapter 4 boss: the first Spider Bot; offers a paper and waits.
members.direction: polite, insistent, offers the paper and waits, British and patient

members.name: THE REGISTRAR
members.bible: Chapter 5 boss: gold Titan Spider Bot that reads the pages.
members.direction: dry and final, gravelly clerk reading a ledger, no hurry

members.name: THE ORDER-BEARER
members.bible: Chapter 6 and wave 30: the Spider Bot that carries the order.
members.direction: slow and ceremonial, low, formal, never angry, only final

members.name: TICK
members.bible: Tick, the clock at the desk: counts hours
members.direction: measured, precise and a little dry; even beats like a clock, weary and courteous

members.name: BRIM
members.bible: Brim, the hat on the hook: wonders whose head it was
members.direction: slow, wistful and gentle, a little muffled like speaking from under a brim

members.name: SPARE
members.bible: Spare, the half-built Yo Bot: chirpy and cheerful about everything
members.direction: small, chirpy and bright; eager and unfinished, a happy appliance

members.name: CHIME
members.bible: Chime, the bell who gives errands
members.direction: clear, light and ringing; kind and a little formal, short sweet phrases
